title: Guide: how to buy your first crypto safely

linkedin.media_title: How to buy your first crypto safely
linkedin.text:
Most people lose money in crypto before they ever make a trade. Not to the market, but to scams, fake apps and avoidable mistakes.

Here is the 5-step checklist I give anyone buying for the first time, wherever they live:

1. Pick a regulated exchange. Check your country's financial regulator list before signing up, and download the app from the official website, never from an ad link.

2. Lock the door first. A strong, unique password and two-factor authentication with an authenticator app, not SMS. Real support staff never message you first.

3. Start with a test amount. Buy a little, send a little to your own wallet, confirm it arrived. Only then move more. Crypto transfers cannot be reversed.

4. Know your local rules. In Nigeria, for example, Binance stopped naira deposits, withdrawals and P2P in 2024, so use SEC-licensed platforms. If you trade peer to peer, release nothing until the money is actually in your bank. A payment screenshot proves nothing.

5. Guard your recovery phrase. Those 12 to 24 words are full access to your money. Write them on paper and never type them into a website or chat. Anyone asking for them is a thief.

Save this for the day you are ready to start.

Education, not financial advice.
